Hey guys. So years ago I invented a game called the evolution game. The first one ran on 4chan's /tg/ board and was a huge success. I ran a few more there and a few people ran copy-cat games (which I also loved). I then took it over to Reddit and had a lot of fun, but like all things, they found a way to ruin it. I still had a few really fun games though. Finally I took it over to 8chan. This was the longest running game, but it's been in its death throws for at least half a year. Still, I get nostalgic.

The game is very simple. You start with a base creature or creatures and edit them via MS paint (or whatever program you prefer). The #1 rule is to ALWAYS SAVE AS .png. It keeps things from going all potatoey. So, if you will allow me, I will introduce you to the creatures and their habitat.

We start off in a dark cavern. For the size of our creatures - it is massive. Life has been the same here for millennia. Something has changed recently though, our once pitch-black cavern has beams of light shinning in from the ceiling. Looks like our little home is in for a big change. A new type of life has been introduced here - plants. They feed on light, which is very strange. Our life has been much more predatory. We are:

Ani - a small insect-like creature that slowly moves across the cavern floor. It scavenges on debris, molds, and fungi. They are docile so they move in packs/schools. They are amphibious and tend to spend most of their time in the cavern's many pools.They reproduce sexually.

Hys - a slug-like predator. It hunts Ani and occassionally Ooq (though they are quite dangerous). While not very fast or aquatic, they are persistent and can even hunt Ani in shallow pools. Once they can get their claw into something, it's dinner. They reproduce sexually, though they are asexual creatures.

Ooq - an amoebae-like creature. They use their stinging tentacles on Hys and Ani alike. They are lazy eaters and take a long time to digest prey. They inhabit pools, but cannot move out of the water. They reproduce by budding.

Mushrooms and Mosses - these may be evolved as well.

The rules are simple. Edit a creature in paint and upload it. If you are evolving someone else's creature, reply to their comment. If you change the name of a creature - you have created a splinter-species. If you keep it the same, you are evolving the main species (both of these points don't have very much impact on the game itself). Keep your creations believable, but don't feel too limited. You can evolve any creature you want as many times as you want, no one owns a creature.

Lastly - have some fun! This is just a creative exercise and not to be taken seriously. If the game is successful, I can make a sub for it. I have always enjoyed running these games. Here is a game I ran on Reddit. It was quite fun. Here is a game I ran on 8chan. The idea was to no provide descriptions for creatures and just do whatever, also very fun.

That's it guys, let's play!
